params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'list' below is an object name (Text); if omitted, 'list' is a hierarchical list reference number (Integer). Required if several representations of the same list exist and you are targeting the current item (second '*' passed), since only object-name addressing distinguishes each representation's own current item.

params.name: itemRef

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the list

params.description: If no item exists with the given reference number, the command does nothing.

params.name: eraseSublist
params.description: If passed, any sublist attached to the deleted item is also erased from memory. If omitted, the sublist (if any) is not erased -- retrieve its list reference number beforehand (e.g. to delete it later with CLEAR LIST) if needed.

overloads.semanticRole: Deletes a single item (or, if the trailing * is passed, its attached sublist too) from a hierarchical list, identified by item reference number, by the sentinel 0 (last item added), or by the sentinel * (currently selected item).

interactionNotes.note: The literal symbol '*' means two unrelated things depending on position: leading = 'list is a name, not a ref number'; in itemRef's slot = 'operate on the current item'.
